entities.summary: Ahidus, also sometimes called ahidous, haidous, tahidoust or hidoussi, is a Berber style of collective performance in Morocco. It is the traditional dance in many Berber tribes and is known to be the favorite entertainment of these tribes. Ahidus is a music genre. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
